Assam Cabinet Approves Land Reform Bill to Boost Investment

The Assam Cabinet has approved a new land reform bill aimed at easing rules for businesses. The legislation introduces automatic land conversion for micro and khadi enterprises, intending to foster investment and economic growth within the state.
